items.title: Drew Timme Waived, Immediately Picked up by Phoenix Suns
items.author: Yahoo Sports
items.body_excerpt: Drew Timme Waived, Immediately Picked up by Phoenix Suns Yahoo Sports

items.title: The Phoenix Suns have claimed Drew Timme off waivers, league sources told HoopsHype. The former Gonzaga star has averaged 5.6 points and 2.7 rebounds in two NBA seasons with the Brooklyn Nets and Los Angeles Lakers. Timme was in training camp with the Minnesota Timberwolves.

items.title: Josh Giddey vs Drew Timme
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
Josh Giddey vs Drew Timme 

I get mad when defenses help off shooters onto Josh Giddey in the paint. Giddey's best attribute is his passing. He drives with the main purpose of trying to draw help and open up a pass.  He's not a legit threat inside the arc. Don't help and make him try to score.
